name: Rambox
author: Rambox LLC
summary: Workspace simplifier - The only way to organize your workspace and boost your productivity
description: Rambox is a workspace organizer that allows you to unify as many applications as you want, all in one place. It is perfect for those who care about productivity while working with many business and personal apps.

versions.release_notes:
Changelog
New
- Focus mode: a timed focus session can be paused and resumed, from the Focus panel and from the tray, and stays paused after a restart. Infinite sessions show Stop instead.
- Command Center: its shortcut can be turned off from the Shortcuts panel, which now shows the combination actually configured.
- Console: support moved to Rambox's own help desk. Your requests and their history are in the console's Support section, also for accounts still on Rambox 2.
- Console: "Custom permissions" lets a team member use a complete set of permissions of their own instead of their sub-team's, so Rambox 2 admins keep their admin access after moving to Rambox 3.
- Sign-in: "Forgot your company ID?" on the enterprise sign-in emails you the company IDs and sign-in links of your organizations.
Improvements
- Custom apps accept intranet addresses (private IPs, ports, query strings, single-word hosts), and the URL field says why an address is rejected.
- Proxy: an app's proxy button says which session profile it configures and how many apps that proxy will route.
- Link rules: the editor refuses to save a rule that can never open a link, warns about rules that point to a missing app or are shadowed by another one, and says how many unfinished rows it discarded.
- Deleting an app, a workspace or a session profile also deletes the proxy credentials it kept on your computer, and leftovers from earlier deletions are removed at startup.
- Basic plan: the tray panel shows the Pomodoro starter with a PRO badge that opens the plans, instead of a starter that did nothing.
- Moving from Rambox 2 with a saved session now asks you to sign in again, instead of signing you out with a license error.
- Console: People marks the members who are still on Rambox 2, so admins can ask them to sign in and complete the move.
- Console: team members who cannot manage teams see team and role names in People instead of IDs.
- Console: deleting a sub-team explains that its members stay in the team and keep their custom permissions.
- Console: "Subscribe" during an organization's trial asks for confirmation with the trial days left and, without a card on file, asks for one first instead of ending the trial.
- Console: coupons valid for a single billing cycle disable the other cycles at checkout.
- Sign-in: "Forgot password" on the personal sign-in takes enterprise accounts to their company's sign-in, instead of saying a reset email was sent.
- Sign-in: accounts that still need to move to Rambox 3 are told so when signing in to the desktop app, instead of getting a server error.
- Sign-in: Rambox Pro 1.x accounts are asked to contact support instead of getting a server error.
- Sign-in: after signing in, Rambox only sends you on to its own addresses.
- Sign-up: organization sign-up shows its progress and cannot be submitted twice.
Fixes
- Fixed the Command Center opening with Ctrl+K while typing in Slack and other apps. It now opens only with its own shortcut, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Space by default, which can be changed in the Command Center settings.
- Fixed sidebar layout, tab position, density, app labels, the master password lock and the language shown in Settings going back to their defaults after a restart.
- Fixed notifications sent by Rambox (announcements and account changes) not reaching the app since October 8.
- Notification Center: Fixed clicking a notification that opens a link or a section not removing it, and notifications that open one of your apps showing the Rambox logo instead of the app's icon.
- Fixed moving the mouse over the tray panel deleting the notifications under the cursor.
- Fixed Tools > Clear local storage not clearing the shared session and the AI assistant's session.
- Fixed a failed reorder of apps or workspaces staying on screen and disappearing on the next restart. The previous order now comes back and an error is shown.
- Fixed removing an app or a workspace hanging without an error in some cases, or the app disappearing only to come back after a restart.
- Fixed starting focus mode from the tray turning on "Infinite (no time limit)" for good, and the tray's Pause ending the session.
- Fixed the timer of an infinite focus session staying frozen in the tray panel.
- Fixed tooltips near the right edge of the window being squeezed into a narrow column, and the Extensions popover now opens leftwards from its button.
- Fixed signing out sometimes leaving the session half-closed.
- Fixed apps of a suite created during onboarding with its own session sharing sign-ins with the rest of your apps.
- Fixed the workspace order being lost for some accounts whose workspace settings had never been saved.
- Fixed an organization's license not updating when its trial ended, a card was added or the subscription was cancelled, until a member reopened the app.
- Fixed the license of an organization moved to Rambox 3 breaking when its subscription renewed.
- Fixed a move to Rambox 3 that was interrupted midway leaving the account unable to sign in. It can now be retried.
- Linux: Fixed the Apps manager and Troubleshooting reporting low free memory on healthy machines.
- Console: Fixed payments and billing failing with a server error after connecting a sign-in method or re-entering your password.
- Console: Fixed a cancellation scheduled from the billing portal still showing as renewing, cancelling again failing, and Resume not stopping it.
- Console: Fixed the organization billing portal offering to switch the organization to the personal Pro plan.
- Console: Fixed invoice amounts of $1,000 or more being shown divided by 100.
- Console: Fixed the "past due" message not saying that the card was declined.
- Console: Fixed changing your email to an address with capital letters leaving the account inaccessible.
- Console: Fixed saving a member without a team taking away all their permissions, and saving an old sub-team from the Rambox 2 panel emptying its permissions.
- Sign-up: Fixed the name you corrected in the sign-up form not being used when signing up with Google or Facebook.
- Sign-in: Fixed the sign-in page getting stuck on its spinner when the desktop sign-in could not continue to the console.
- Website: Fixed the download buttons on rambox.app sometimes giving the Rambox 2.7.2 installer or the GitHub releases page instead of the latest installer for your system.
Known bugs
- Windows: right-clicking the tray icon can also open the Windows taskbar menu.
- Linux (Snap): the app runs under XWayland and can look blurry on Wayland with fractional scaling.

Changelog
New
- Downloads show a notification as soon as they start, with a progress bar, the file name, how much has been downloaded and a Cancel button; when the download finishes it turns into "Download complete".
- AI assistant: it can be turned off entirely ("I don't want to use AI") from its consent screen or from Settings > General, which hides its titlebar button, the side panel, the selection popover and "Ask AI" in the context menu.
- Themes: every theme now has a Light / System / Dark selector, in Settings and in the onboarding, which replaces the separate "System" theme. Glossy, Slate and Darkest can be used in light and dark.
- Console: a "Sign-in & security" section in My account to change your password, connect or disconnect sign-in methods, and request a "create a password" email for accounts without one.
- Console: hover your avatar in My account to upload and crop a new profile photo.
Improvements
- Quick View: arrow keys navigate like WASD, clicking a card opens that app, and workspaces and cards show the same unread badges as the sidebar, with each workspace's own icon.
- AI assistant: the consent screen explains that Rambox has no built-in AI and that the assistant opens the AI service you choose, signed in with your own account.
- AI assistant: the "Ask AI" popover on selected text appears only after you accept the assistant's consent, and can be hidden from its own footer.
- AI assistant: when the AI service is signed out, Rambox asks you to sign in to it in about a second, instead of after several seconds with a "the page may still be loading" warning.
- The "high memory usage" suggestion is shown at most once every 30 minutes per app.
- Organization themes follow your Light / System / Dark choice, and changes to the organization's colors apply without restarting.
- Linux: the zip package extracts into a Rambox folder, like the tar.gz.
- Console: the move to Rambox 3 wizard addresses an organization's admins as admins instead of as the owner.
Fixes
- macOS: Fixed the Save, Delete and close buttons of the workspace, app and settings panels not responding.
- Fixed apps not loading in the background when there was a disabled workspace. Apps now load in sidebar order.
- Fixed removing an app or moving it out of a tiles workspace leaving behind an empty tile that could not be removed. Existing broken tiles are repaired.
- macOS: Fixed the "high memory usage" suggestion showing constantly.
- Fixed the chosen theme changing after a restart, and dark themes staying light when following the system.
- Fixed some preferences (AI assistant options, default link handling, waking hibernated apps) going back to their defaults on every start.
- Basic plan: Fixed "Continue" failing in the workspace choice after deleting the workspace you had chosen.
- AI assistant: Fixed questions and actions from the selection popover being lost when the panel was closed.
- AI assistant: Fixed "Summarize" sending the previous selection after clicking a link.
- AI assistant: Fixed questions from the selection popover being sent with a Spanish label whatever the app's language.
- Downloads: Fixed "Open folder" being offered only when the folder had already been opened, and the file name showing its full path on macOS and Linux.
- MCP: Fixed apps added through the MCP server being created without a URL.
- Linux: Fixed the app crashing at startup when launched without flags (AppImage, from a terminal, tar.gz and zip).
- Linux (deb, rpm, Snap): Fixed the app not starting because its install folder was only accessible to root.
- Linux: Fixed the main window never appearing on some setups, staying behind the loading window.
- Linux: Fixed signing in from the browser not returning to the app on AppImage, tar.gz and zip builds.
Known bugs
- Windows: right-clicking the tray icon can also open the Windows taskbar menu.
- Linux (Snap): the app runs under XWayland and can look blurry on Wayland with fractional scaling.

Changelog
New
- Basic plan: when a trial or subscription ends, or an account moved from Rambox 2 lands on Basic, a wizard explains what Pro included and lets you choose, once, the workspace your plan keeps.
Improvements
- Rambox keeps working offline for up to 48 hours on the last license the server confirmed, with a countdown banner, and checks again as soon as the connection is back. While offline, only the license banner is shown.
- Basic plan: apps in locked workspaces open their settings read-only and no longer count towards the app limit.
- A disabled workspace can be selected in the sidebar and shows an Enable button; disabling the workspace you are in switches to that view right away.
- Unified Search: disconnecting or deleting an app revokes Rambox's access at the provider (Google, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Asana and Discord), unless another app still uses the same account.
- Unified Search: Google Calendar search covers every calendar in your list, including shared and subscribed ones.
- Unified Search: the settings card says your data stays on your computer and links the privacy policy, and the provider sign-in tab always shows its address bar with the full URL.
- Windows: a left click on the tray icon brings up Rambox, and a right click opens or closes the tray panel.
- Console: an account that has not moved to Rambox 3 yet is taken to the move wizard before using the console; "Not now" signs you out.
- Sign-in: signing in with an email or Google account that has no Rambox account takes you to sign-up with the email filled in, instead of "Invalid email or password."
- Sign-in: "Resend email" on the verification page has a 60-second cooldown with a countdown, and asks you to wait a minute instead of showing a server error.
Fixes
- Fixed HTTPS certificate errors being ignored.
- Fixed the telemetry opt-out not being honored by the app for personal accounts.
- Fixed startup errors caused by settings saved by an earlier version.
- Fixed a deleted workspace coming back in the sidebar after a plan change.
- Fixed the license banner countdown not being shown.
- Fixed the "subscription expired" dialog downgrading the license when you had just paid with it open.
- Fixed an error when pressing Enter or Esc while renaming an app.
- Fixed the proxy test in an app's settings not receiving the app's URL.
- Windows: Fixed the tray panel and the Command Center flickering when shown.
- Console: Fixed moving the account to Rambox 3 from the web signing you out right after.
- Console: Fixed billing and checkout showing an error for accounts not yet moved to Rambox 3.
- Sign-in: Fixed "Forgot password" sending several reset emails on repeated clicks.
- Sign-in: Fixed sign-up failing for people who created their login in Rambox 2.7 but never finished the account.
Known issues
- Windows: right-clicking the tray icon can also open the Windows taskbar menu.
- Linux: We are working to provide the installers ASAP.

Changelog
New
- Rambox 3: a redesigned interface, with a new titlebar, sidebar and panels.
- Themes: Default, Glossy, Slate, Darkest, Mint and Pink, each with a light and a dark variant.
- Command Center: a floating launcher, opened with a global shortcut from anywhere, to jump to any app, workspace or action.
- Tray panel: notifications, focus/pomodoro controls and quick actions from the system tray (menu bar on macOS).
- Notification Center: the notifications of every app in one panel, newest first, with "clear all" and middle-click to dismiss.
- AI panel: Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Gemini in a side panel, with the option to attach the content of the app on screen, and of other apps, to your question.
- Concentration panel: focus sessions and a pomodoro timer, with ambient sounds and an optional full-window mode that keeps everything else out of reach until the session ends.
- Quick View: all your apps in a grid, to glance at them and switch.
- Unified Search: connect Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and Calendar, Outlook, OneDrive, Teams, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Asana, Trello, Jira, Discord and WhatsApp, and search them from the Command Center.
- Open links in installed apps: a link to a service you already have in Rambox can open in that app. Rules live in Settings → "Default apps for links", with * wildcards.
- Address bar: an optional bar above each app with its URL and back, forward, reload/stop and home. Without it, those buttons live in the titlebar.
- Sidebar: a new "Split" layout with workspaces and apps in separate bars, a resizable splitter, overflow menus, and drag and drop to reorder workspaces and to move an app to another workspace.
- Hibernated apps can wake up as soon as you open them (new setting in General).
- Windows: media controls (go to app, previous, play/pause, next) in the taskbar thumbnail while an app is playing.
- Onboarding redesigned as a full-window flow, with a shorter tour and hint dots that explain each feature where it lives.
- OS permissions: onboarding and Troubleshooting show the state of camera, microphone, screen sharing, location and Bluetooth, and ask for what is missing.
- Remote Control (MCP): an optional setting to let an MCP client control Rambox.
- Console: one billing page for personal and enterprise accounts, with plan changes, payment methods, multiple tax IDs and cancel/reactivate.
- Console: change your account email, and sign out of all devices.
- Console: a support portal to open and follow tickets.
- Console: organization admins manage teams, sub-teams, their permissions and shared workspaces, and choose the organization's sign-in methods.
- Sign-in: new sign-in and sign-up pages.
Improvements
- Sign-in now happens in your default browser instead of inside Rambox.
- Billing and Profile open in the console in your browser, already signed in, instead of an embedded page.
- Rambox asks the OS for camera and microphone only when an app actually needs them, and for screen recording before opening the screen picker.
- Hibernated apps wake up on the page they were on.
- Settings reorganized in vertical tabs.
- One density setting now scales the whole app, not just the app tiles.
- User profiles are shown as cards with how many apps use each.
- Resource-usage suggestions have Hibernate, Reload and Disable buttons.
- A pending update shows as a badge on the profile photo.
- Pro features are marked with a PRO ribbon, also during the trial.
- Signing out of all devices from the console now also signs out Rambox.
- Enterprise members stay on the stable update channel.
- Windows and Linux: new app icon, matching macOS.
- Sign-in: enterprise invitees see the inviting organization's logo.
Fixes
- Fixed moving an app to another workspace corrupting the order of the workspace it left.
- Fixed the proxy test reporting success for a proxy that cannot carry a request.
- Fixed "Clear local storage" leaving behind the sessions of apps in tiled or disabled workspaces.
- Fixed an app's error page being treated as a lost internet connection.
- Console: Fixed the profile name and photo reverting to an old value after a page refresh.
- Sign-in: Fixed a failed email/password sign-in taking a long time to show "Invalid email or password".
End of Support
- Signing in to Rambox 3 moves your account to the new Rambox 3 format. Once moved, Rambox 2 can no longer sign in with that account, and Rambox 2 windows left open on other computers are signed out.
Known issues
- Linux: We are working to provide the installers ASAP.

Changelog
Improvements
- Upgraded Electron to v43.0.0 (Chromium 150.0.7871.46). :electron:
- General improvements in extensions handling.
Fixes
- Fixed the download folder picker not defaulting to the selected folder.
Extensions
- Fixed popups not being sized correctly, showing trimmed pages (workaround for an Electron regression not yet fixed upstream).
- Fixed some extensions showing a blank toolbar icon when none was defined in their manifest.
- Fixed extension context menus sometimes rebuilding repeatedly while navigating within a page.
- 1Password: Fixed autofill icon not present.
- Bitwarden: Fixed login popup not loading.
- Bitwarden: Fixed context menu autofill option.
- Boomerang: Fixed some render issues.
- Dashlane: Fixed the account creation flow hanging after logging out, including when the tab was still loading.
- Dashlane: Fixed autofill icon not present.
- Google Translate: Fixed the popup's click-to-translate feature failing to access the page.
- Grammarly: Fixed the inline spell-checker failing to connect.
- Grammarly: Fixed toolbar icons and underline indicators not displaying correctly.
- Keeper: Fixed being logged out immediately after login.
- Keeper: Fixed autofill icon not present.
Known bugs
- Keeper: Sign in page sometimes not loading correctly.
- 1Password: Login popup not loading.

Changelog
New
- Option to set the Tray icon color: "Auto" (default, follows system), "Light" or "Dark".
Improvements
- Upgraded Electron to v42.5.2 (Chromium 148.0.7778.271). :electron:
- Windows: Added option to change the installation directory during setup.
- Linux (Flatpak): Upgraded to Flatpak runtime version 25.08.
Fixes
- Orphan processes kept alive. Now it should wipe them out correctly (if present).
- Refactor Windows and MacOS signing tool. Now all installers and executables are correctly signed.
- MacOS: added NSAudioCaptureUsage permission to allow access to system audio when screen sharing.
- Linux: prevent startup crashes on Linux Wayland sessions.
- Linux (Snap): added "wayland" plug for proper Wayland support.
- Linux (Flatpak): Fixed audio permission.
- Linux (Flatpak): Fixed apps name.
- Linux (Flatpak): Fixed apps icon.
- Fixed a crash when clicking an extension's icon in the toolbar.
- Fixed extension popups not closing properly in some cases.
- Fixed a crash caused by certain background requests (e.g. searching "weather" in Google, which loads an analytics request that could crash the app).
- Fixed popups (mostly authentication) being unable to communicate to their parent app under COOP restrictions.
- Fixed LinkedIn redirect links showing a 404 error.
- Fixed TikTok Studio failing to load.
- Fixed the "Auto Wake Up" interval setting not being saved.
- Fixed adding a custom app with an alias/internal hostname being rejected as an invalid URL (e.g. "http://localhost:8080/").
- macOS: Fixed the .dmg installer showing an extra folder instead of the Rambox app itself.
- Linux (Flatpak): Fixed missing audio in some implementations.
- Linux (Flatpak): Fixed the app name shown by the desktop environment.
- Linux (Flatpak): Added missing package metadata for software stores.
- Linux (Snap): Fixed startup by adding the required no-sandbox and ozone-platform launch arguments.

Changelog
Improvements
- Upgraded Electron to v41.1.1 (Chromium 146.0.7680.166). :electron:
- Proxy settings: auto-parse URLs pasted into the host field.
- Import apps from browser history for Onboarding.
- Now .dmg installer for MacOS is signed.
- Internal "Alerts" UI obscures other services and disrupts tab focus.
New
- Option to Hide Notification Content Preview (per app or globally).
- "Copy link URL" for images in Context Menu.
- Auto Wake-up Interval for Hibernated Apps: users can configure an automatic wake-up interval for apps that are hibernated.
- Per-app Proxy Sync Scope: Each app can now have its proxy settings scoped as local-only or synced across devices.
- Flatpak Support: Rambox can now be distributed and run as a Flatpak package on Linux.
- MacOS users can now use their iPhone as a camera input within Rambox apps.
Fixes
- Fixed popups not using the parent app's partition on macOS and Linux.
- Linux: Fixed startup issues for AppImage packages.
- Fixed app icon not showing correctly in .tar.gz and .zip packages on Linux.
- Fixed scroll buttons flickering on window resize in the navigation bar.

Changelog
Improvements
- Upgraded Electron to v40.7.0 (Chromium 144.0.7559.225). :electron:
Fixes
- Fixed "Use Here" toggling machine to inactive, due to race condition.
- Fixed EOS alert banner causing app to hang on boot.
- Fixed DRM validations for Windows.

Changelog
Fixes
- Fixed a compatibility issue with App Badge notifications in some web services.
- Enhanced OS detection to correctly identify macOS Tahoe.
- Re-added cert signing for Windows (both installer and executable).
- Fixed Linux updater. Previously it was pointing only to .snap version instead of correct extension (.snap, .deb, .appImage, .rpm and tar.gz).
- Fixed issue where icons were not showing in the Workspace Config "Select icon" drawer.
- Fixed several silent warnings.

Changelog
New
- Localization feature implemented 🌐.
  - Added: German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Chinese (simplified)
- Tour feature implemented 🧭.
Improvements
- Build and packaging process optimized, resulting in smaller installers and a cleaner internal structure.
- Windows: improved app icon resolution on taskbar and system tray.
- macOS: updated app icon to better match native macOS standards.
- Extensions: update extensions feature to allow more and newer extensions (complying with Chrome Extension Manifest v3).
- Extensions: improved popup positioning depending on apps tab bar position.
- Extensions: better icon handling.
- Improved tabs contrast colors for lighter themes.
- Automatically scroll to active tab when adding/removing or selecting it in any way.
- Now promotions show to eligible users only.
- Improve security and fail-safe when using the "Inject JavaScript Code" app setting and other code injections.
Fixes
- Google Meet sharing screen randomly stops streaming.
- Allowed instances of the same app were being incorrectly counted (only for Basic users).
- Opening the Add drawer through a tile workspace was showing incorrect "pro" ribbon.
- Apps tab popover was showing squared elements when tabs didn't fit inside the Tab Bar and scroll buttons were present.
- Telegram (Option 1 only) showing blank page.
- Fixed access Rambox Support page within Rambox.
- Fixed DRM validations for Windows and MacOS, allowing Spotify (and other media players) to work as expected.
- Snap package is included again in release files.
- Ubuntu: fixed incorrect icon.
- Ubuntu: fixed error where app couldn't be added to the dock bar.
- Fix support link access from menu bar.
- Some silent warnings and errors were mitigated.
- Google Meet: Backgrounds and effects are now fixed.
- Google Chat: unread counter working as expected.
Chore
- Extensions: removed some old/useless/duplicate extensions.
- Extensions: added new extensions and update others to newer version.

Improvements
- Upgraded Electron to v37.6.0 (Chromium 138.0.7204.251). :electron:
- Better handling of orphan processes at Rambox start.
- Show "Sign out" button at "Inactive Device" page.
- Distinguish the functionalities of the Pro plan from Basic and Trial users.
Fixes
- App crashes when opening emails with "rich snippets" in Gmail (Sheets, Drive, etc.).
- Several fixes regarding users being unable to use the current device after clicking the "Use here" button.
- Kill some orphan processes after closing the app.
- Several UI fixes in some cases where user workspace was totally empty.
- Fixed few minor errors in Tab Bar when Temp and Promotion tabs are present.
- Fixed some scroll button calculations in Tab Bar.
- Fixed excessive WindowServer GPU usage on macOS Tahoe 26. See https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/48400
Chore
- Now, HTML links to Rambox's billing section open Billing inside Rambox app.

Improvements
- Upgraded Electron to v37.2.5 (Chromium 138.0.7204.168). :electron:
- General performance improvements across the app.
- Allow discarding notifications from Notification Center with middle click.
Fixes
- Removed rounded corners due to instability and performance issues caused by an Electron bug.
- Fixed mouse wheel scroll when tabs are positioned horizontally.
- Improved mouse wheel scrolling to be faster and proportional to scroll movement (minimum scroll: 1 tab).
- macOS: fewer visual flashes when entering/leaving fullscreen.
- Minor UI fixes in navigation bar.
Chore
- Re-enabled animation on app icon mouse over.
- Added --force-os-theme command line flag to enforce app theme (e.g. --force-os-theme="light").
- Added --force-default-titlebar command line flag to use the OS default titlebar instead of the custom titlebar.

Changelog
New
- New tab and app Layout: new tab system and design to ease navigation between Apps and Groups and improve performance. 🚀
- Prioritize Badge count over "Need Attention" dot. If the app should have both badges, change badge count color.
Improvements
- Upgrade to Electron v37.1.0 (Chromium 138.0.7204.35) :electron:
- Better tab spacing and overflow.
- Allow IPv6 URLs when adding a Custom App.
- Link handling improvements.
- Automatically change tray icon colors according to OS' dark/light theme.
- Add an option to show the workspace title on the tab bar.
- Add animation when changing the active tab.
- Improve crash report handling.
- Improve app sort functionality.
- Improve several of our internal components to ease performance.
- Reduce unnecessary updates to tabs views.
- New badge icons positioning to prevent overlapping (playing sound, hibernated, close).
- When initiating Rambox, if last app does not exist anymore (i.e. temp tab), select previous one.
- Now, when an app is hibernated, keep badges if any.
- Spellchecker: Support for multiple languages, improved default and “none” options, and ability to set multiple or no languages as default.
- Prevent app hibernation if app is streaming.
- Bypass Focus Mode and Work Hours if app is streaming.
- Show alert when app is inside Work Hours. Allow bypass restrictions temporarily (sounds and notifications).
Fixes
- Workaround to prevent credential popup issue in some Apps (Gmail, Discord, etc.). See https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/47147.
- Context menu not showing in popups.
- App crash when opening some emails in Gmail (Sheets, Drive, etc.).
- Sometimes the app randomly crashes (related to orphan process).
- Now badges and dot notifications bubble up and refresh correctly in any update case.
- Fixed several problems regarding shortcuts navigation.
- Now after navigation ends, Last App shortcut goes to the one where navigation started.
- Fixed active App highlight position and size when changing navigation toolbar in any way (Density, Apps Position, Show app title, etc.).
- Apps position bottom or top hidden when selecting Tiles group.
- Wrong URL in "Release notes" in About Section.
- Bug on hide tab title for top and bottom tabbar.
- Extension's popup positioning when the apps' position is other than "Left".
- Using the spell checker feature in Google Chat from Gmail crashes the app.
- Badge not disappearing when disabling groups.
- Workspace labels are not shown when the tab bar position is either top or bottom.
- Some apps need to be focused to get fully loaded on autostart.
- General settings: Issues while applying the app's display behavior changes.
- Arrow keys navigation stopped working.
- When disabling a group, the empty view was not showing correctly.
- Newly created group was not showing the tab bar correctly.
- Incorrect style of tab bar when group is empty.
- Notification Center badge positions.
- Apply theme color to the "Don't hibernate this app" switch.
- Extensions: Extensions popover does not change between the full and empty list.
- Extensions: Sometimes extensions popover was not showing correct icons.
- Remove workspaces, sometimes made tabs to flicker ordering.
- Sometimes the "rollback logic on error" was causing flickering in tabs order and other features.
- Opening a temp tab through a tile does not work. Now, it opens the temp tab in the tiles group level.
- Disabling a group was not removing Rambox's overlay icon badge.
- Sometimes after navigating with arrow keys through workspaces, after a second, the active workspace was changed incorrectly.
- Enterprise: New workspaces were added at start of navigation tab (Intermediate users only).
- Dot badge now shows correctly in Notification Center tab.
- Unstable taskbar badge.
- LinkedIn redirect links won't open.
- Fixed geolocation errors in some applications.
- Can't exit full screen mode from embedded video (Mac only).

Changelog
Improvements
- Adds the option to choose between rounded or sharp corners for the apps.
Fixes
- Fixes UI glitches in some Windows 11 & macOS Sequoia devices.
- Profiles maintenance settings are not working as they should.
- Linux:  Use the native titlebar to ensure compatibility between distros.
- Horizontal layout: Tabs without labels show an empty space where the label should be.
- When the app has an empty title, the Quick Settings are not displayed correctly.
- macOS:  Sonoma & Sequoia devices are detected as "macOS Unknown".
- Prevent issues while loading new themes.
- Spacing between tabs is not equal.
- Linux: Restore Auto-hide menu bar option in General Settings.

- We still have a different electron version on Linux than on Windows and macOS.
- We apply our brand, and remove all related to Electron from the UA in the main process.
Fixes
- Linux: Media Keys not working on snap package (user must give permissions).
- Prevent showing the "open all in tabs" link handling option in tiled workspaces.
- Prevent apps to start hibernated when the user adds them.
- Prevent Rambox from locking by inactivity when there is one or several apps streaming audio or video.
Improvements
- Informs the user if there's low space available on the HDD.
- Enhanced stability and performance of apps' runtime.

Fixes
- Monday.com not retaining login information.
